name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Levinbolt) — 3 Advanced — Eye of the Storm

system.description: You become a dervish of shimmering electrical energy: anyone looking at you suffers the Negative Mental Trait Oblivious from the glare (and anyone using Heightened Senses is dazzled outright). You can snap electrical charges into targets for four levels of lethal damage and a stun, up to three such attacks, and the nimbus surrounding you scorches anything that touches you besides. The power lasts for a number of turns equal to your permanent Willpower Traits, or until spent.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
